svg.text: What to do

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: • Don't reply, click anything or pay. Block the sender and report the message.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: • Never pay a 'fee' to receive a prize, parcel, loan or job. Don't send gift cards, crypto or

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: wire transfers to people you haven't met.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: • Check the claim yourself: open the official app or type the website address manually.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: • Don't tap the link. Type the official address yourself.
